title: SimulationRun
description: Schema for a single simulation run result, validating data hygiene and provenance as per Constitution Principle VI.

network_id.description: Unique identifier for the network graph used in the simulation.

seed.description: The random seed used for this specific simulation run.

diffusion_rate.description: Calculated rate of change of spatial variance (finite difference).

steps_run.description: Number of time steps executed in the simulation.

status.description: Final status of the simulation run.

generation_algorithm.description: Name of the algorithm used to generate the network graph (e.g., 'erdos_renyi', 'watts_strogatz', 'barabasi_albert').

parameter_values.description: Dictionary of parameters used during graph generation and simulation.
